message: 聖沙１－１ササミ
Continuing from last night, I'm studying for my exams in my room.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」
I had my textbook open on the desk and was running my mechanical pencil across my notebook, but my movements gradually slow down.
This isn't a good sign. Even though I'm going through the motions of studying, nothing is sinking into my head.
My eyes are merely tracking the text mechanically, far from actually reading it carefully.
My fingers are definitely writing out sentences, yet looking at the characters, I get the illusion that they're just meaningless symbols.

name: Synn
message: 「It's all going right through me... This means I've been slacking off on my daily studying」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though the exam is tomorrow, isn't this bad...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, just as I suspected」

name: Synn
message: 「What do I do? What should I do?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know! I'll deliberately lie down and think about it」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's the mindset of a total deadbeat!」

name: Synn
message: 「Fwaaaaahhh」
Yawning, I lean my upper body back to lie down just like that--

name: Misa
message: 「Kyan!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha-wha?」
What is this? Halfway through leaning back, my head is suddenly enveloped in a warm, soft sensation.

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... n-no... st-stop... I didn't mean to... b-but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, it's so soft and smells great」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Idiot... That's not true...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did I own a pillow like this?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? A pillow?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhah!?」
My upper body falls backward onto the floor just as planned. However, since I hadn't expected the pillow to vanish, I ended up smacking the back of my head squarely on the floor.

name: Misa
message: 「...Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa?!」

name: Misa
message: 「What's the big idea, blowing off studying for your tests?! What happened to our competition!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah~~」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa?!」

name: Misa
message: 「You literally just did that a second ago」

name: Synn
message: 「I sorted out the situation and got surprised all over again. Up... we go」
I sit up and face Misa, who had shown up without me noticing.

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, here I am」

name: Synn
message: 「I have about three questions for you, is that alright?」

name: Misa
message: 「Bring it on. I don't have a guilty conscience about anything」

name: Synn
message: 「First, number one」

name: Synn
message: 「Why were you holding your breath right behind me? If you'd just announced yourself properly, I would've welcomed you in」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy asked me to do it like that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heck yeah! Synn-sama wasn't making any progress on his test prep, see. At times like this, Hiss is the only one who can knock some spirit into him!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So I guided her in and let her secretly trespass」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not a crime, okay? Paqy opened the door for me」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... alright, number two then」

name: Synn
message: 「I get how you got into the room. But how did you get from the front gate to the entrance?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't hear any sounds of you wrestling with Sasami tonight」

name: Misa
message: 「Once I've fought a mere chicken acting as a watchdog once, I can read all its moves」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cock-a-doodle-doo!」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cock-a-doodle-doodle-doo」

name: Sasami
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「Third question」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, ask me whatever you want」

name: Synn
message: 「What's something you're bad with, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Dark places」

name: Synn
message: 「Ohh」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr! We're-stu-dy-ing!!」
Misa repeatedly slaps the low table, urging me to resume studying for the test.
She's completely right. I'd better behave and follow Misa's advice.

name: Synn
message: 「You're studying for the test too, Misa. So you weren't just acting as my supervisor」

name: Misa
message: 「Didn't I tell you? I'm competing against you on equal terms, Sakura-kun?」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, I could say the exact same thing right back to you」

name: Misa
message: 「I was too nervous to notice last night, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「You normally study at home too, don't you. No, even more than normal」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, it only looks that way because I'm cramming overnight」

name: Misa
message: 「What a blatant lie」
Misa picks up my notebook and examines the contents.

name: Misa
message: 「Not only what was written on the board, you've even taken detailed notes on the key points the teacher mentioned during class」

name: Misa
message: 「Since a single class period is limited, it inevitably ends up as hasty scribbles and messy handwriting...」

name: Misa
message: 「...Every day at home, you recall the class content, add your own annotations, and neatly rewrite your notes all over again, don't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Studying for tests is just an extension of your usual diligent effort...」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, so you weren't actually a genius, Sakura-kun, what a letdown」

name: Paqy
message: 「You probably think you're being sarcastic, but that won't work with such an honest smile on your face, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「No fair, let me see your notebook too, Misa」
Misa's notebook, which I was seeing for the first time, made generous use of margins and was written with visual clarity as the top priority.
Neat handwriting whose balance never wavered. Markings in red and blue ballpoint pen.
In some places, fluorescent green and pink markings had been applied.

name: Misa
message: 「...I-I underlined too much, so you can't tell which parts are important, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a lie. You're using different colors and combining them depending on how important something is, aren't you」

name: Misa
message: 「How did you see right through that at a glance!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, this part looks super helpful. Let me copy it down for a bit」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll copy yours too, Sakura-kun. There was a part I didn't understand just now... is that okay?」
There's no way I'd refuse.
We studied for the test by teaching each other the parts we didn't understand and showing each other our notes.
We were more efficient than when handling Student Council duties, and even though we were chatting, we could keep up our concentration.
Having a partner like this makes me really happy.
Scratch, scratch, scratch, scratch
Scratch, scratch, scratch, scratch

name: Synn
message: 「It's already this late... Let's grab a light bite to eat and push through a bit more studying」

name: Misa
message: 「Good idea. If rice balls and miso soup are fine with you, I'll whip them right up」

name: Synn
message: 「That miso soup is already gone, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「...W-Was it so gross you threw it out?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope, I drank it all」

name: Misa
message: 「Impossible. I mean, I made so much of it」

name: Synn
message: 「One bowl before bed, two at midnight, one upon waking, one for breakfast, one for lunch, two for dinner, and one before studying--and then I hit the bottom of the pot...」

name: Misa
message: 「Just how much did you drink!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Your miso soup was delicious, Misa, so I couldn't help it」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I-I didn't make it!」

name: Misa
message: 「A mystery demon broke in, made dashi from bonito, sardines, and kelp, stirred in miso, added chopped tofu, fried tofu, and scallions, then went back to the Demon World!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If a demon like that existed, Synn-sama would have way less to stress over」

name: Synn
message: 「Then maybe I'll make curry rice tonight for that kind, cooking-loving Demon」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's make it a healthy curry packed with veggies from the home garden. Sound good, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph! Why are you asking me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, do ya really need to return the favor? No guarantee that Demon's gonna come back again」

name: Synn
message: 「I suppose...」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh...? Y-You're not gonna make it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, instead of a Demon who might or might not show up, I'll make it for Misa, who's right here」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank--mm, mmm, ahem, cough!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph! If you want to make it, then just make it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, and if you want some too, Misa, feel free to eat up」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I don't really--」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Goodnight, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks to you, Misa, I made great progress studying for the test. Thank you」

name: Misa
message: 「T-Thanking me is completely off the mark. I just want to compete fair and square, that's all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're planning to run home tonight too?」

name: Misa
message: 「I just feel like breaking into a run」

name: Paqy
message: 「In short, that means you're happy, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm not pleased at all!」
Feelings aside, Misa isn't used to the roads around here. There's no telling when she might trip...
That said, she probably wouldn't let me walk her home either... Hmm.

name: Synn
message: 「...Paqy, could I ask a favor?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to me!」
When Paqy smacked his own head, the black patches around both of his eyes began to shine like spotlights.
Two eerie beams of light brightly illuminated the night road.

name: Misa
message: 「That puts me at ease. You're wonderful, Paqy-san\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'll leave the rest to you」

name: Synn
message: 「But as a fundamental question, if a huge light shines from a spot like that, won't it blind Paqy's own eyes?」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-Shut up already!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Paqy-san, don't mimic the way I talk!」
Paqy teases Misa and runs off.
Misa chases after her. Maybe Paqy is closer to Misa than she is to me.
